phoneticConvention: English approximation in the style of the Melunga deck (phe field): dway-boo-chee = 对不起, may gwahn-shee = 没关系, ching = 请. Syllables of one word are joined with hyphens, words are separated by spaces. Tones are not shown: see the pinyin (reading field) and the audio. Standard Mandarin, simplified characters.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended. Linguistic review required (tones, naturalness of phrasing).
title: Plans and suggestions
goal: Talk about plans, suggest and organise an activity.

model.note: 打算 + verb = to plan to, to intend to.

variants.phon: woh dah-swahn shyweh keye-chuh.

variants.reading: wǒ dǎsuàn xué kāichē.

variants.phon: woh dah-swahn hwahn goong-dzwoh.

model.note: 会 here announces what is going to happen (prediction, commitment). It is not required: 明天我在家 is often enough, since 明天 carries the future.

readiness: You can announce a plan (打算, 要 + future time marker, 会), suggest an activity (我们…，怎么样？), ask if someone is free (有空吗), set a day, time and place, decline with an alternative (我不行，不过…) and confirm (那就…，说定了).
